_comment: Recorded Decision candidates for records inside the Held-out Window (after the 2024-06-30 cutoff). Used only when the fixture is built with a later cutoff (whycode.fixtures.FIXTURE_WINDOW_END).

pr:127200.choice: Lower the default schemachanger.job.max_retry_backoff cap from 20 seconds to 10 seconds
pr:127200.rationale: A 20 second cap left stuck jobs waiting too long after short outages.
pr:127200.quote: Lower the default cap to 10s because 20s left stuck jobs waiting too long after short outages.

rfc:20240715_schema_change_retry_policy.choice: Cap schema change job retry backoff at ten seconds
rfc:20240715_schema_change_retry_policy.rationale: Twenty seconds left stuck jobs waiting too long after short outages.
rfc:20240715_schema_change_retry_policy.quote: Schema change jobs should retry with a backoff capped at ten seconds, because twenty seconds left stuck jobs waiting too long after short outages.
